task: Write a Python function that extracts the AWS account ID from an ARN string. The function should take an ARN as input and return the 12-digit account ID.
Create a JSON object that represents an AWS S3 bucket policy allowing public read access to all objects in the bucket named 'my-public-bucket'.
Write a regular expression that matches valid AWS EC2 security group IDs. Valid IDs start with 'sg-' followed by 8 or 17 hexadecimal characters.
